svg.title: Frozen 40-gene evidence matrix
svg.desc: All 40 frozen B0/G1 pool genes; external expression direction, full-family q, source genetics, conflict status and intervention uncertainty. Unavailable mapping is not a negative genetic test.

g.text: Frozen pool: 40 genes, separate evidence layers
No supported target shortlist: 0 same-direction external q < 0.05; 1 limited genetic mapping / 40; intervention direction unknown / 40.
Genes are ordered by B0 rank; selection badges identify the frozen expression (B0) or network-propagation (G1) top 20.
Direction = sign agreement with the frozen discovery coefficient; opposite signs alone do not establish a precise biological conflict.
q = BH adjustment across all 17,643 externally tested genes. A large q means insufficient evidence here; it does not prove no effect.
Unavailable genetics = no mapping in the prespecified 2023 source, not 39 negative tests. SKIDA1 annotations reuse one publication.
Not established conflict / unknown intervention = evidence not established, not absence of conflict or proof that activation/inhibition helps.
The deterministic dossier rule selected only inconclusive PARP9 (hold); no precise opposite-effect or supported dossier emerged.
Rows include all frozen pool members; full IDs, effect intervals, missing reasons and provenance remain in replication_v2_dossier_pool.tsv.
